title: Foreshadow registry
description: All foreshadow (伏笔) entries for the novel. Tracks what is planted, what is resolved, and what is still pending.

planted_at.description: Chapter id where the foreshadow was planted, e.g. v01-c003.

resolved_at.description: Chapter id where it was resolved, or null if still pending.

status.description: planted = set but not yet paid off; resolved = paid off; abandoned = intentionally dropped.

description.description: What the foreshadow is — enough for a reviewer to check it pays off.

payoff.description: How it was resolved (required when status=resolved).
